A '''Rebel base''' was on [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Tendaar Eng">[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base (Adventure Book)'']] Tendaar Engineer Character Folio</ref> The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Soaring Dactillions]] was assigned there at one time to test the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing prototype]]. It was [[Assault on Cardooine|assaulted]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Zal">[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base (Adventure Book)'']] Zal Ace Character Folio</ref> but the action was stymied by the actions of the tech expert [[Tendaar Bel]].<ref name="Tendaar Eng" /> The Dactillions took heavy casualties in the battle.<ref name="Zal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base was mentioned in Zal Artha and Tendaar Bel's Character Folios included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
